arguments.summary: Critical firewall integrity breach and host compromise initiated via phishing. An infected finance workstation (WS-FIN-042) beaconed to a Cobalt Strike C2 server, enabling lateral movement attempts. Exploitation of CVE-2026-21884 led to corruption of 47 inbound firewall rules, permitting unauthorized access on high-risk ports. Immediate containment actions included host isolation, user credential reset, full endpoint scan, and malware cleanup. The firewall rule table corruption presents an ongoing critical risk requiring urgent remediation.

timeline.description: Initial compromise: WS-FIN-042 establishes outbound HTTPS connection to known malicious IP 198.51.100.23 (Cobalt Strike C2).
Malicious rundll32 execution detected on WS-FIN-042 from Temp directory, indicative of payload execution.
IDS alerts on Cobalt Strike beaconing from WS-FIN-042 to 198.51.100.23. Correlation confirms C2 activity.
Lateral movement attempt: Failed Kerberos TGT request from WS-FIN-042 to domain controller.
Lateral movement: Successful SMB access from WS-FIN-042 to file server WS-FIN-050.
Firewall integrity alert triggered on primary perimeter firewall (10.0.1.1).
Containment: User CORP\jsmith's credentials reset, WS-FIN-042 isolated via firewall block, full EPP scan initiated.
Remediation: Ansible playbook executed to clean WS-FIN-042. Malware (Dropper.Linux.Agent.F) detected in cron job.
Critical Finding: Firewall rule corruption confirmed. 47 of 52 inbound rules compromised via CVE-2026-21884.
